# ZAWYA: Oman, China sign 23 investment partnerships worth billions of dollars

By Staff Writer

Beijing, China – Oman and China signed 23 investment agreements and cooperation partnerships worth several billion US dollars, including plans for two joint investment funds worth a combined US$1.1bn, as the sultanate seeks to attract Chinese capital and technology into strategic sectors.
